workstreams.owner_requirement: Five independently controlled cryptographic authorities: OWNER, G23, G24, G23_2 and G24_2; fresh non-replayable scope-bound decisions.
workstreams.claim: Cryptographic identity, provenance, decision chronology, issuer custody and revocation are independently assessed.
workstreams.acceptance: Exactly five unique public trust identities are root-protected and their separate operators are externally attested; a current strongly signed request is approved in order without replay.
workstreams.verification: Compare exact source and live-host hashes, validate external_gates signatures and expiration, test cross-state and global replay.
workstreams.validation: Independent G23 checks each phase; G24 reviews G23 evidence and signs an exact current object only with sufficient evidence.
dependencies: Owner-controlled public trust anchors outside repository

workstreams.claim: CUSTOSZ source review, independent validation and Maestro handoff are evidenced on exactly the candidate source SHA.
workstreams.acceptance: CUSTOSZ reviews this exact build using a registered pinned adapter and publishes reproducible findings; independent G23/G24 and Maestro produce authentic decisions.

workstreams.validation: Separate independent technical review of worker evidence and certifier role/authority before accepting Maestro handoff.
risks: Supervisory selftest misreported as material review
dependencies: Registered SHA256-pinned LRB CUSTOSZ review adapter

workstreams.validation: Independent G23 validates recovery and regression; G24 independently certifies final integrated object after fresh postboot evidence.
